$comment: English renderings for the Vietnamese words that appear inside spec VALUES.
The seed is extracted from Sony Vietnam's specification pages, so a value
keeps that page's wording and punctuation — see the Do/Don't table in
docs/HANDOVER-sony-product-specs.md. Numbers, units and Sony's decimal
comma are language-neutral and are never touched here; only the words are.
Keyed by FIELD, because the same word is not the same word in two rows:
`điểm` is autofocus POINTS under `autofocus` and screen DOTS under `lcd`
and `viewfinder`. A global dictionary would silently mistranslate one of
them, so there is no global dictionary.
`literals` is an exact whole-value match and wins over `replace`.
`replace` is an ordered list of substring swaps — longest first, because
`triệu điểm` has to be spent before `điểm` can match inside it.
Vietnamese is the canonical value. This file only renders it for `en`.

literals.hình ảnh CMOS full-frame 35 mm một chip: Single-chip 35 mm full-frame CMOS image sensor

replace: Không có đế gắn chân máy
